notes.title: Update V1.3
notes.content:
-Fixed issue where aim sensitivity was extremely high (caused by it being tied to the fps)
-Aim sensitivity only affects controllers now

notes.title: Read if you're having frame rate issues!
notes.content: [p]It seems that Vsync can drastically lower fps and cause input delay, so if you're having any of these issues, try turning it off. [/p]

notes.title: Update V1.2
notes.content:
-Aim sensitivity option added
-Can now change volume and sensitivity settings via the pause menu in game

notes.title: V1.1 Notice
notes.content: [p]If you're having issues running the game after the update, please reinstall the game, and it should be fixed![/p]

notes.title: Update V1.1 (fixed)
notes.content: -The game should run now (issue with the executable)

notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.content:
-Full controller support added!
-3rd volume option added (for cutscenes)
-Default settings option added
-Prevented anything related to timing (stamina, battery drain, etc.) from being tied to frame rate
-Greatly decreased the chance of the bean copter from flipping violently
-Increased the radius in which FCS will enter the bean copter (now much easier for him to enter it)
